searchDocs.title: Range​
searchDocs.content: </> type Range = { lo: Version, hi: Version?, source: string } Abstracted datatype that represents a deconstructed range, including a low & high (if provided) version, and the source string it came from.

searchDocs.title: Version​
searchDocs.content: </> type Version = { major: number, minor: number, patch: number } Primitive datatype that represents a deconstructed version, split up into their respective components.

searchDocs.title: ConvertibleVersion​
searchDocs.content: </> type ConvertibleVersion = Version | string Abstracted datatype allowing you to either pass a deconstructed Version, or a semver string that will then be deconstructed.

searchDocs.title: FromString​
searchDocs.content: </> VersionApi.FromString(version: string) → Version Translates a semver string into a Version object. Places that are held by a wildcard (*, X, x), or cut off as a partial, will be replaced with zeros. Example: VersionApi.FromString("1.2.3") --> {major = 1, minor = 2, patch = 3} VersionApi.FromString("1.2") --> {major = 1, minor = 2, patch = 0} | (Partial) VersionApi.FromString("1.X.x") --> {major = 1, minor = 0, patch = 0} | (Wildcard) VersionApi.FromString("1.*") --> {major = 1, minor = 0, patch = 0} | (Wildcard)

searchDocs.title: ToString​
searchDocs.content: </> VersionApi.ToString(version: Version) → string Translates a Version object into a semver string. Example: local version_a = VersionApi.FromString("1.2.4") local version_b = VersionApi.FromString("2.*") Version.ToString(version_a) --> "1.2.4" Version.ToString(version_b) --> "2.0.0"

searchDocs.title: ReleaseType​
searchDocs.content: </> type ReleaseType = "major" | "minor" | "patch Defines the specific release types defined within the version string.

searchDocs.title: Comparator​
searchDocs.content: </> type Comparator = ">" | ">=" | "<" | "<=" | "==" | "!=" Defines any comparator that can be used in a free comparison function, such as cmp(v1, Compartor, v2), and it will call the correlating comparison. "===" and "!==" do simple string comparison, but are included for completeness.

Throws if an invalid comparison string is provided."===" and "!==" do simple string comparison, but are included for completeness.

searchDocs.title: compare​
searchDocs.content: Comparison </> CarrotCore.compare( v1: ConvertibleVersion, v2: ConvertibleVersion ) → number View this on npm semver docs Return 0 if v1 == v2, 1 if v1 is greater, or -1 if v2 is greater. Unlike a JavaScript Array.sort comparator, this numeric result cannot be passed directly to Luau table.sort(), whose comparator must return a boolean. Use lt as the sort comparator for ascending semantic-version order (for example, table.sort(versions, lt)).

searchDocs.title: coerce​
searchDocs.content: Coercion </> CarrotCore.coerce(version: string) → string View this on npm semver docs Coerces a string to semver if possible. Aims to provide a very forgiving translation of a non-semver string to semver. It looks for the first digit in a string, and consumes all remaining characters which satisfy at least a partial semver, up to the maximum permitted length (256 characters). Maximum length for any semver component considered for coercion is 16 characters; longer components will be ignored (10000000000000000.2.3.4 becomes 2.3.4).
